0.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_000
0.description: Ever a sight for sore eyes, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. By now it's no secret, but we can't well continue our work without you.

1.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_001
1.description: As always, let us begin by taking stock of the situation. Through our previous investigation, we learned that the founders had sealed away the primal Eureka on this isle.

2.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_002
2.description: However, Ejika then came along and, acting at Eureka's behest, sabotaged the proto-aetheryte─what may be considered the beating heart of the ward. On account of which the ward has ceased to function.

3.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_003
3.description: For a blessing, we discovered a way to restore it: by infusing magicite with copious amounts of aether to create a new focal point. It took considerable time and effort, but the preparations are now ready. All that remains is to reach the primal and seal it away once more.

4.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_004
4.description: In order to do that, as per our original objective, we must gain entry to the Students' headquarters. However, this has been rendered complicated owing to a number of factors.

5.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_005
5.description: Aside from lying beyond impassable terrain, the structure is protected by a ward of its own─did you ever doubt it? Ordinarily, members of the Students are able to teleport inside, but the high concentration of aether we've measured makes doing so extremely dangerous. We must ascertain the conditions first, or we risk not emerging from the Lifestream.

6.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_006
6.description: So I've a mind to enter via the “back door,” as it were. Yet this method of ingress, too, isn't without its problems, but it's better to explain it out in the field.

7.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_007
7.description: ...And that's where we stand. Now, before we set out, there's one last matter I'd like to attend to.

8.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_008
8.description: You see, I had tasked the expedition scholar with researching legends pertaining to Eureka. Call it a scholar's hunch, but I thought that a hint might be scrounged from amongst the tales. But come, let us see what the good scholar has dug up for us.

9.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_010
9.description: Greetings, Mistress Krile, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! May I assume you have come about the legends?

10.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_011
10.description: Indeed we have. Did your efforts bear fruit?

11.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_012
11.description: They did, I'm pleased to say. First of all, it must be noted that there are several legends describing the forbidden land, Eureka.

12.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_013
12.description: Despite their many divergences, however, all are united in one detail: that Eureka was a repository for transcendent weapons hidden beneath the Crystal Tower.

13.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_014
13.description: Combining this fact with your account of Eureka's avatar forging a blade for Master Ejika, I'm led to conclude that the primal possesses the ability to create weapons.

14.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_015
14.description: Weapons forged by a primal, put in the hands of mortals... What could possibly go wrong?

15.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_016
15.description: In <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> visions, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> heard the words “exposure places the bearer's very soul at hazard,” did <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> not? I take that to mean that those who wield such weapons are at risk of becoming the primal's vessel.

16.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_020
16.description: This calls to mind Urianger's report on the Dark Divinity, Odin, and his sword Zantetsuken. The primal was not the rider, but the weapon.

17.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_021
17.description: Odin is said to have appeared during the age of the Allagan Empire. It may well be that Zantetsuken was forged by Eureka.

18.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_030
18.description: Recognizing the danger, the Allagans sealed Eureka's weapons beneath the Crystal Tower. And this gave rise to the myriad legends of a “forbidden land”...

19.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_031
19.description: Curious, though... Assuming Eureka was born of prayers, one would expect a deity the likes of Byregot to manifest. A brawny smithy working the forge.

20.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_032
20.description: Yet what we have is a primal possessed of an autonomous avatar, which goes around promising power and glory. Not the kind of entity that would arise from homespun legends. No, it feels all too purposeful. Calculated.

21.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_033
21.description: But such musings are for another time. I have some few things to prepare in order to make use of the aforementioned back door. In the meantime, would you go and pay Gerolt a visit?

22.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_034
22.description: I understand he's devised yet more ways to ease your labors. Come and find me when you're done speaking with him.

23.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_035
23.description: A moment, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. There is one more matter I wish to speak with you about.

24.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_036
24.description: It pertains to the members of the Students believed trapped inside the headquarters. We've been speaking of rescue, but based on what we know, that may be an overly optimistic view.

25.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_037
25.description: The concentration of aether we've measured inside the tower is, to be blunt, not conducive to life. Certainly not over long periods. And all this time, there's been no observable movement from within.

26.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_038
26.description: Of course, the Students are knowledgeable and skilled folk, and they may have found some way to survive. But even as we cling to this hope, we should prepare ourselves for the worst.

27.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_INV00463_000_039
27.description: Forgive me for bothering you with gloomy talk. I won't keep you any longer; pray go and seek out Master Gerolt!

28.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_040
28.description: I'm sorry, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but my preparations will take a while. Have you spoken with Gerolt yet?

29.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_050
29.description: Everything sorted with Gerolt? Excellent. Let us set out at once!

30.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_051
30.description: ...Is what I'd like to say, but I'm afraid I need more time to complete my tasks.

31.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_052
31.description: Rather than standing idle at camp, though, may I suggest you acquaint yourself with the area outside? I should be able to complete my tasks meanwhile.

32.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_053
32.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 51.

33.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_060
33.description: I'm sorry, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I need more time to complete my tasks. May I suggest you acquaint yourself with the area outside?

34.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_061
34.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 51.

35.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_070
35.description: Apologies for the wait! We now have everything we need to make use of the back door. To be sure, there's still a couple of things that require doing out there.

36.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_071
36.description: First, let us head to the Central Columns. It's due south of here, at the Val River Source. I'll explain everything once we arrive.

37.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_072
37.description: Oh, and I should mention that, from this point on, I'll be delegating the bulk of my duties to the good scholar. If you ever want for guidance, she's the first person you should seek out. Without further ado, then!

38.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_080
38.description: <pant> Once again, I'm reminded of this isle's dangers... <pant> And how much of a boon you are to our efforts.

39.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_081
39.description: Without the lessons of your field investigations to draw upon, I don't think I would've made it here in one piece.

40.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_082
40.description: So, the back door. It's an aetherbridge that conveys you to the tower's entrance, built for those who lack the ability to teleport.

41.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_083
41.description: It's usable only by those with special permission, and right now it's not usable at all due to the obstruction in the Lifestream.

42.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_084
42.description: In order to restore operation, we must repair the three sets of columns of the aetherbridge.

43.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_085
43.description: This requires that we seek out spots of pooled aether...

44.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_086
44.description: ...And deploy these regulators to restore the flow. I would be grateful if you could assist with this task.

45.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_087
45.description: According to my readings of the nearby area, the aether has pooled in two locations along the river source, one in the north and another in the south.

46.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_088
46.description: I will search in the north, if you would do likewise in the south. You should have luck looking east of the Aetherbridge Foundation.

47.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_090
47.description: Leave this area to me and see to the south, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You should have luck looking east of the Aetherbridge Foundation.

48.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_100
48.description: By my readings, I presume you've found and rectified the pooled aether. Excellent. With some minor adjustments, these columns will be in good order again.

49.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_101
49.description: This may take a little time, though, so sit tight for now. Or go and smite the local wildlife if you prefer. I'd certainly welcome fewer of them snapping at my heels.

50.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_102
50.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 54.

51.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_110
51.description: I'm still working on the adjustments. Be patient just a little longer.

52.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_111
52.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 54.

53.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_120
53.description: The adjustments are complete, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Let's put our handiwork to the proof, shall we?

54.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_121
54.description: Yes, everything appears to be in order. Hopefully the remaining two sets of columns will prove no more difficult.

55.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_122
55.description: With that, let us make for the Western Columns. It's just south and east of Unverified Research. Right, silent as a mouse, silent as a mouse...

56.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_130
56.description: B-By the gods, but that was close... I literally saw into its gullet. Ugh, cannot unsee... <shudder>

57.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_131
57.description: ...Forgive me, I'm all right now. So, it appears there are two spots of pooled aether in this area as well.

58.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_132
58.description: Both are located in the northern reaches of the west bank. Let us split up and find them.

59.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_140
59.description: <pant> Of all places for it to be... <pant> You may want to keep an eye up...

60.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_150
60.description: There you are, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, and I see you managed to locate the other spot of pooled aether. I'll begin making my adjustments at once. As before, it may take a bit of time.

61.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_151
61.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 57.

62.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_160
62.description: Apologies, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I'm still working on the adjustments. Feel free to wander about and cull the beasts.

63.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_161
63.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 57.

64.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_170
64.description: Sorry for keeping you waiting! I've finished with my adjustments─let us see if they did the trick.

65.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_171
65.description: Good, no dramas here either. That leaves us with just the Eastern Columns.

66.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_172
66.description: As the name suggests, they're located on the eastern bank of the river. Off we go, then─and no more harrowing encounters!

67.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_180
67.description: After all this sneaking about, I've gotten somewhat used to it. Still, I'm a long way off strolling around this island as if it were a flower garden like you do.

68.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_181
68.description: But on to business. Again, we have two spots of pooled aether to account for. One is due east of here, while the other appears to lie at the northern edge of the river bank area.

69.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_182
69.description: I'll head east if you wouldn't mind taking your search north. See you back here afterwards, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

70.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_190
70.description: I appreciate your zeal, but one person's quite enough for this area. See to the other spot to the north, would you?

71.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_200
71.description: The regulator is in place? Excellent. As before, I'll need to carry out some adjustments. Pray bear with me a while.

72.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_201
72.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 60.

73.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_210
73.description: I'm not done yet, I'm afraid. This being the last set of columns, I'm taking extra care to ensure nothing is amiss.

74.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_211
74.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 60.

75.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_220
75.description: Apologies for making you wait repeatedly. I'm pleased to say I've completed my adjustments, and with even greater care than usual. I don't even need to try to know that this will work.

76.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_221
76.description: See, what did I tell you? With all three sets of columns thus repaired, the aetherbridge should be operational again. At long last, we may enter the tower.

77.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_222
77.description: I've taken the liberty of granting you permission to use the bridge, so we may make the crossing at any time. Come, let us make our way thither.

78.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_230
78.description: This is it, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The path to the tower lies wide open.

79.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_231
79.description: Within, we are like to encounter both Ejika and Eureka's avatar. They won't allow us to simply walk in and restore the ward, yet that is precisely what we must do. After all of our toils to reach this point, we cannot stop now. Let us go!

81.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_241
81.description: Well, I don't think any of us expected it to be right by the entrance. I know for a fact that it wasn't here before. One can only assume it was moved from its hiding place.

82.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_242
82.description: At any rate, this saves us the trouble of a search, so I shan't complain. Now, as much as I would like to restore the ward at once, that restraint will interfere with its effects.

83.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_243
83.description: It's a safety measure that prevents Eureka from escaping, but by the same token it prevents us from acting against it.

84.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_244
84.description: I'll wager that Ejika is searching for a way to deactivate the restraint and release Eureka. Which means that we must find it first.

85.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_245
85.description: Grandfather's office adjoins this hall. If there is any information to be had, I daresay it will be there.

86.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_250
86.description: Apart from the mess, it's pretty much as it was. I can almost see Grandfather sitting at his desk.

87.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_251
87.description: Hmmm, if Ejika had been here, he is long gone. What could that boy possibly be up to...?

88.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_252
88.description: Well, never mind him for now. Come, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, help me look for information on the restraint.

89.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_260
89.description: Hardly surprising, but there's no “Eureka” section. We must dig a little deeper.

90.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_270
90.description: Found something, did you? Excellent, so did I. A wealth of information inside an unassuming tome.

91.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_271
91.description: Grandfather describes the ward the founders raised, the contrivances they employed to keep Eureka hidden, and─most pertinently─instructions on deactivating the restraint.

92.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_272
92.description: He also writes in detail about Eureka's avatar. Contrary to what we first assumed, the entity appears to be more akin to an instrument. 'Tis Eureka's means of manipulating aether, without which the primal cannot forge its weapons.

93.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_273
93.description: So long as Eureka itself exists, the instrument can be recreated over and over again, but it will disappear if we sever the aetheric connection between them. This we can accomplish by restoring the ward and sealing Eureka away.

94.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_274
94.description: While it falls short of outright eliminating the primal, it presents an effective way to keep it in check. I wonder, perhaps Ejika is...

95.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_275
95.description: Well, all will come to light in due course. That is all from me. Let's hear what you have learned.

96.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_276
96.description: I see... Yes, I remember. On that fateful day, Grandfather gave the order for immediate evacuation.

97.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_277
97.description: But when I attempted to teleport away, the magick failed owing to an unnatural surge in the Lifestream. So I turned my steps towards Port Surgate to find a boat.

98.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_278
98.description: I never got there, of course. I was swallowed up by the Lifestream.

99.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_279
99.description: Judging by the state of the headquarters, the others too were pulled into that raging torrent. But there was no divine intercession for them.

100.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_280
100.description: I had braced for this. From the beginning, I had resigned myself to being the sole survivor. But to now be confronted with the truth...

102.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_282
102.description: Right. There'll be time for tears later. We have work to do, and Grandfather would expect us to do it.

103.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_283
103.description: Come, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Let us deactivate the restraint.

104.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_290
104.description: This, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. According to Grandfather's notes, this little thing is the crux of the restraint. Apparently, it shares a history with Eureka...but such details aren't relevant at the moment.

105.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_291
105.description: What matters is it allows us to release the restraint. Here I go.

106.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_480
106.description: That did the trick. Let us return to the hall.

107.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_481
107.description: Of course they would choose this moment to appear.

108.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAPERSON_000_482
108.description: (-Eureka-)Our enemy standeth before us, bearing light most vile. Strike <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> down, my champion.

109.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_483
109.description: Aye, I was waiting for you to lift the restraint, as I knew you would.

110.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_484
110.description: Ejika, please! Come to your senses!

111.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_485
111.description: Come to my senses? My dear Krile, I never took leave of them. Come, we settle this now─the task that Master Galuf entrusted to us!

112.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_486
112.description: Adventurer, the blessing of Light shields you from the primal's influence! Take the sword, and strike down the avatar!

114.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_488
114.description: Wicked, you say? Yours is the existence that threatens the world, primal. My conscience is quite clear.

115.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_489
115.description: Before making wise retorts to the primal, perhaps you would care to explain...well, everything?

116.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_490
116.description: What is there to explain? I acquired the weapon needed to defeat Eureka's avatar and set up an ambush. Isn't it obvious?

117.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_491
117.description: I thought that you would be able to deduce my plan of winning the enemy's confidence, but it seems I overestimated you.

118.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_492
118.description: <sigh> That's our Ejika. All's well that ends well.

119.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_492
119.description: Ahem. Aren't we celebrating a little early?

120.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_493
120.description: ...Yes, our Ejika indeed. My apologies. I'll restore the ward at once.

121.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_494
121.description: No, Krile. That is not what we need to do.

122.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAYOUNGD_000_500
122.description: I'm against sealing it. If it's possible to slay Eureka, that is what we must do.

123.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAYOUNGG_000_501
123.description: (-Galuf-)In the absence of an avatar, its master might command it to forge more weapons than the aether it harbors. This is true.

124.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAYOUNGK_000_502
124.description: And without the means to replenish its aether, it will eventually consume itself.

125.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAYOUNGZ_000_503
125.description: This will not work, my friends. Surely you see the flaw in this method.

126.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAYOUNGD_000_504
126.description: What, that master and eikon are one and the same? That our aether would be Eureka's aether? Aye, we know this, but we've got a responsibility.

127.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAYOUNGG_000_505
127.description: (-Galuf-)As those who unearthed the being... If my life can set things to rights, gladly would I render it up. Yet therein lies the problem.

128.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAYOUNGZ_000_506
128.description: Eureka harbors tremendous aether. Far more than the four of us combined. We would all perish long before we succeed.

129.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EUREKAYOUNGK_000_507
129.description: ...Well, my friends, it seems we have no choice at all.

130.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_510
130.description: Let me guess: you had another vision?

131.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_511
131.description: How very timely. And now you know what I seek to do.

132.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_512
132.description: Now, wait here! What exactly <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> you planning to do?

133.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_513
133.description: Hmph, how many times must you make me state the obvious?

134.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_514
134.description: Master Galuf conceived of a way to destroy Eureka, and I mean to carry it out.

135.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_515
135.description: Out of the question! If the four founders together couldn't do this, what makes you think you alone can?

136.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_516
136.description: Eureka expended vast amounts of aether to bring the Isle of Val out of the Lifestream. Even accounting for what it has since recovered, my aether alone should more than suffice.

137.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_517
137.description: If that's the case, then I should be the one to do it! It's my solemn responsibility as the sole survivor of the destruction!

138.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_518
138.description: Protected by your blessing as you are, Eureka will not recognize you as its master. Only I can do this.

139.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_519
139.description: Having read Master Galuf's memo, you should know the danger the primal poses. We cannot risk it falling into Ascian hands again. Destroying it now is the ideal solution.

140.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_520
140.description: There's nothing ideal about a solution that requires you to sacrifice yourself. Besides, I didn't think a self-centered fellow like you would aspire to martyrdom!

141.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_521
141.description: Such puerile provocation ill becomes you, Krile. And no matter what you say, you cannot deny the truth. Sealing Eureka away would only be a temporary measure. Nay, we must destroy it, here and now.

142.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_100_521
142.description: If Master Galuf believed it possible, he himself would have done the deed. And it is possible now. I have already made my peace; let me do what must be done.

143.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_522
143.description: What you seek to do, there's no undoing! It's suicide, plain and simple, and as your comrade I cannot allow it!

144.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_100_522
144.description: With Emmerololth vanquished, there's no immediate danger! While Eureka is contained, we can search for other ways to deal with it!

145.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_523
145.description: Your assertions are all too easily refuted, but 'tis plain you have already made up your mind on the matter. The best thing to do here is to defer to a third party.

146.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_525
146.description: Adventurer. Without you, we couldn't have gotten this far. You have as much say as any of us on how we should proceed.

147.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_526
147.description: ...Very well. I trust <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>'s judgment. Whatever be <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> decision, I will accept it.

148.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_100_527
148.description: There you have it. To defeat Eureka here and now, or to restore the ward and delay the inevitable... Make your choice, adventurer.

149.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_528
149.description: The story will unfold differently depending on whose approach you choose to support.

150.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_529
150.description: Once you begin upon one path, the other will no longer be available to you.

151.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_530
151.description: Please note, however, that your choice will not affect the rewards and challenges to come.

152.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_540
152.description: Admittedly, sealing Eureka away does not end it, but we shouldn't rush our decision as Ejika seems to believe we must.

153.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_541
153.description: Once the ward is operational again, we'll have ample time to consider the best course of action. Surely you agree with me?

154.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_542
154.description: Should you give your support to Krile's approach, Ejika's path will no longer be available to you.

155.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_543
155.description: Please note, however, that your choice will not affect the rewards and challenges to come.

157.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_YESNO_002
157.description: Are you certain you wish to support Krile's approach?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>※By proceeding, Ejika's path will no longer be available to you.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

158.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_550
158.description: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I knew we would be on the same page.

159.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_551
159.description: So, Ejika. That is two against one in favor of restoring the ward.

160.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_552
160.description: Hmph, lost your nerve, have you? I would try to impress upon you the danger of this course, but I would only be wasting my breath.

161.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_553
161.description: If it's to be the ward, then so be it. I will cooperate with you. Be thankful.

162.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_554
162.description: I'm thankful, truly I am. If you were to lend us your keen mind, I'm confident we will find a true solution.

163.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_555
163.description: Without further ado, then, I will reactivate the ward.

165.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_561
165.description: I would sooner see it destroyed, as you know, but it's at least a step in the right direction. What next?

166.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_562
166.description: We have much and more to discuss. Shall we return to camp for the time being?

167.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_563
167.description: We will go on ahead. See you anon, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

168.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_570
168.description: Ah, there you are. I received word a short while ago, but both Rowena and Hancock have come to observe our efforts.

169.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_571
169.description: To spare ourselves a bit of repetition, let us wait to have our discussion in their presence.

170.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_610
170.description: So, you've done it─destroyed all of Eureka's unholy creations. Excellent work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

171.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_611
171.description: ...What brings us here? In short, we have a plan.

172.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_612
172.description: An idea occurred to me at the Waking Sands, you see, and I had returned to the isle to discuss it with Ejika.

173.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_613
173.description: While promising, it was contingent upon the success of your mission. I'm pleased to see that you didn't squander my efforts to send you to the upper level.

174.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_614
174.description: So, it is as we had deduced. The weapons had gained sentience owing to their awakening as primals.

175.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_615
175.description: Tell me, adventurer. If Eureka were destroyed, what do you suppose would become of its aether?

176.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_616
176.description: To spare you Ejika's riddling─ordinarily, it would return to the aetherial realm, but this is not the case when the weapons are near. Nay, being primals in essence, they would be quick to absorb such untethered aether.

177.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_617
177.description: Aye, and thus were the weapons an impediment to the plan.

178.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_618
178.description: I had conceived of a number of methods to defeat Eureka without the need to sacrifice my life.

179.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_619
179.description: The most promising of these involves the use of teleportation. In the moments before Eureka drains me of all my aether, I would retreat into the Lifestream to safely emerge after the primal's demise.

180.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_620
180.description: However, all it takes is one of Eureka's voracious weapons to cause the plan to go awry.

181.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_621
181.description: For even should its maker cease to exist, there is a high probability that it would consume my aether ere I can make good my escape.

182.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_622
182.description: Lest you wonder, my idea was based on Y'shtola's use of Flow to flee into the Lifestream. I put it to Ejika, but of course he had already considered it and explained to me this caveat.

183.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_623
183.description: But thanks to you, adventurer, the weapons are no more. Naught remains to hinder the execution of the plan.

184.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_624
184.description: Indeed. We may now defeat Eureka while ensuring Ejika's safety. I shall stand at the ready to deal with the unforeseen.

185.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_625
185.description: Well, I suppose your assistance would be better than none at all. I'm in your hands, Krile.

186.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_630
186.description: Whew... Though the risk was small, I couldn't help but feel nervous.

187.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_631
187.description: On that, we are in agreement. I must say I'm a little tired.

188.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_632
188.description: Let us return to camp, then. I daresay you've earned a good rest.

189.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_633
189.description: We will go on ahead. Come and see us after you've made your own way back.

190.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_640
190.description: 'Twas a long and arduous road, for you not least of all, but we finally did it. We defeated Eureka.

191.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_641
191.description: If truth be told, I did not expect that you could rally so many comrades and destroy all of the weapons.

192.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_642
192.description: You are a paragon of your kind, adventurer. Should the opportunity arise, I shall look forward to depending on you again.

193.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_643
193.description: Well, I do not rightly recall a time when Ejika admitted to depending on anyone. You may consider that an honor, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

194.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_644
194.description: Now then, as much as I'd like to linger and savor our success, I do have other responsibilities. I shall be on my way. Thank you, my friend, for everything.

197.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_647
197.description: Allow me to thank you as well. None of this would have been possible without you. Should your path ever lead you back to this isle, know that you will always be welcome here.

198.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_650
198.description: Ah, there you are. I received word a short while ago, but our financiers have come to observe our efforts.

199.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_651
199.description: I had reported that our mission was close to completion, and it seems they wished to see things with their own eyes.

200.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_HANCOCK_000_660
200.description: My friends, I am heartened to see you hale and whole! By this, may I assume that business is indeed concluded here?

201.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_ROWENA_000_661
201.description: We've read the report. Tell us what happened after.

202.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_662
202.description: ...And that's how it unfolded, Ejika sacrificing his own life to defeat Eureka.

203.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_HANCOCK_000_663
203.description: By the kami, such a brave and selfless act... He will not soon be forgotten.

204.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_ROWENA_000_664
204.description: So, what now? This did turn out to be your isle, after all.

205.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_665
205.description: There's considerable cleaning up to be done, retrieving all the research material and the like. For this task, I will request that a team be dispatched from the Sharlayan motherland.

206.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_666
206.description: We would be grateful if your two concerns could provide support to said Sharlayan contingent. In return, the Students shall grant you the rights to use the isle for your trading activities.

207.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_HANCOCK_000_667
207.description: We will need to draw up the details of the agreement, but I see no reason why we would reject your proposal. On a personal note─what of yourself, Mistress Krile? What do you intend to do next?

209.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_669
209.description: I will rejoin the Scions. My presence is no longer required here. Rest assured I will make the necessary arrangements with my countrymen.

210.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_HANCOCK_000_670
210.description: I see. In that case, perhaps it would be best to save discussing the finer points for afterwards. In the meantime, would you mind if the expedition continues with its work?

211.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_671
211.description: Not at all. Be my guest.

212.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_ROWENA_000_672
212.description: That's all for now, then. We'll be in touch again come negotiation time.

213.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_673
213.description: Well, we should be getting back to our duties as Scions. We mustn't let grief halt our steps, lest a certain someone smirk at us from beyond.

214.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_674
214.description: Come, my friend. Let's carry on─for Ejika.

215.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_SYSTEM_000_675
215.description: You may now ride mounts within Eureka Hydatos!

216.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_680
216.description: So, you've done it─destroyed all of Eureka's unholy creations. Excellent work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

217.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_681
217.description: ...What brings me back to the isle? In short, I have a plan. One that required the success of your mission.

218.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_682
218.description: That you were on a foray to the upper level when I arrived was opportune, and I decided to seek you out.

219.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_683
219.description: As you know, when a primal is vanquished, its aether is given back to the aetherial realm. However, I believe this was not the case with Eureka, owing to the nearby presence of its weapons.

220.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_684
220.description: Having become primals in essence, the weapons would have been quick to absorb such untethered aether.

221.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_685
221.description: This fact gave me hope, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─hope that Ejika may still live.

222.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_686
222.description: You see, when Ejika set about destroying Eureka, he didn't have the air of a person going to his death. I couldn't shake the feeling that he was planning something. Thus did I decide to see where the trail of his aetheric essence led.

223.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_687
223.description: And what should I find but evidence that he had used a teleportation magick. I believe he intended to escape into the Lifestream before Eureka drained him of all his aether.

224.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_688
224.description: The idea was that he would reappear after the primal's demise. Yet he never did, and it's highly likely that his aether was caught in the tenacious pull of Eureka's weapons.

225.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_689
225.description: But thanks to you, the weapons are no more. There is a chance that we may pluck Ejika out of the aether─as the Elder Seedseer once did for Y'shtola.

226.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_690
226.description: To that end, I went to Gridania to learn this technique. And I mean to put it to the proof right now.

227.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_691
227.description: Without further ado, then. Wish me luck!

228.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_700
228.description: Let me guess: the adventurer destroyed Eureka's weapons, then you pulled me out of the aether.

229.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_701
229.description: That's...precisely what we did. Don't tell me you had anticipated this too?

230.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_702
230.description: That's too much credit even for me. As accomplished as <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> is, I did not count on the adventurer defeating all the weapons. And it was highly unlikely that my aether could be reformed.

231.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_703
231.description: There was a sliver of a chance that I would survive, but the fact is I was prepared for the worst.

232.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_704
232.description: You saved my life. And for that, I thank you.

233.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_705
233.description: An unbegrudging show of gratitude from you? Well now, strange things do happen.

234.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_706
234.description: Ejika is doubtless tired. I will accompany him back to camp and see that he gets some rest. Come and join us later.

235.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_710
235.description: 'Twas a long and arduous road, for you not least of all, but we were able to rescue Ejika. Permit me to thank you as well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

236.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_711
236.description: So, I've heard what took place in my absence, but what now for the two of you?

237.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_712
237.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> and I both have our duties, and we shall return to them.

238.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_713
238.description: In that case, you may leave the isle's outstanding affairs to me. I had considered myself a dead man; the least I can do is tend to the aftermath.

239.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_714
239.description: Thank you. It's reassuring to know that the isle is in your care.

240.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_KRILE_000_715
240.description: I shall be on my way, then. Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, for everything.

243.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4KRILE_00545_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_718
243.description: Allow me to thank you again. Among other things, I wouldn't be standing here were it not for you. Should your path ever lead you back to this isle, know that you will always be welcome here.
